messages.subject: Compiling INLA
parts:
Hi

I am trying to compile INLA on my local machine from the instructions on the FAQ. I'm using a 64 bit laptop with an i7 core running Ubuntu 12.10 with gcc 4.7.2.

The process fails and I don't know how to fix it.

I get the code:
wget http://www.math.ntnu.no/inla/build-yourself/linux.tgz
tar xvzf linux.tgz

Running:
ls linux

yields:
amd
Makefile
metis-4.0
muparser_v134
muparser_v134.patch
taucs-2.2--my-fix
zlib-1.2.3

When running 'make' in the "linux" directory I am informed to "Edit the Makefile, especially the 'FLAGS' variable" and run
make download
make zlib
make gsl
make lapack
make metis
make taucs
make amd
make muparser
make GMRFLib
make inla

I use the flags:
FLAGS = -std=gnu99 -march=native -mtune=native -mfpmath=sse -msse4.2 -O3 -ftracer -pipe

If I just use
make download
in the directory "linux", a lot of new things are downloaded and the Makefile is overwritten. Hence I make a new directory and run
make -f <path-to-linux-folder>/Makefile download

This works (in the sense that I don't get errors) and a lot of stuff is downloaded to the new directory.

The options 'zlib', 'metis, 'taucs', 'amd' and 'muparser' works *if* I'm in the "linux" directory.

The options 'lapack', 'GMRFLib' and 'inla' fails with outputs about missing dirs/files. E.g.:
make: *** lapack-3.2.1: No such file or directory.  Stop.
make: *** [lapack] Error 2

How can I get these missing folders? And am I doing something wrong in e.g. the download step?

Best,

Robert DJ

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Compiling INLA
parts:
On Thu, 2013-09-19 at 02:37 -0700, Robert DJ wrote:
> Hi
>
> I am trying to compile INLA on my local machine from the instructions
> on the FAQ. I'm using a 64 bit laptop with an i7 core running Ubuntu
> 12.10 with gcc 4.7.2.

try download

~hrue/hfiles/build64.tgz

and edit GNUmakefile to your compiler

this is a copy of the directory using to build the inla-binaries.

you'll need to do

make update

and that's all you need, I think.




--
Håvard Rue
he...@r-inla.org
